fichas.title: Libraries: Basics, Space Calculation, and Environmental Requirements
fichas.summary: Guidance for library planning covers shelf spacing and book capacity, structural grids and floor loading, environmental conditions, safety, construction, circulation, and book transport. The page includes tables for storage capacity and live floor loads, plus recommendations for user areas, stacks, and book-processing spaces.
